summary: AGM Group Holdings furnished a 6-K reporting board changes and the closing of a previously disclosed private placement. Ms. Jianping Niu resigned as independent director and committee chair, with Ms. Rui Zhang and Ms. Li Zhang appointed effective October 5, 2026; Mr. Hailiang Jia shifted to Nominating Committee chair. Separately, the company closed a September 17, 2026 share purchase agreement with Vastway Technology, selling Class A shares at US$0.6305 for about US$11.0 million gross, representing roughly 77.2% of outstanding ordinary shares and 63.6% of voting power. No premium, advisor, or recommendation was disclosed; change-of-control dynamics and board independence warrant monitoring.
